nodes.description: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to a fraction (n × a)/(n × b) by using visual fraction models , with attention to how the number and size of the parts differ even though the two fractions themselves are the same size. nodes.label: 3.NF.A.1

nodes.description: Apply properties of operations as strategies to add and subtract.* Examples: If 8 + 3 = 11 is known, then 3 + 8 = 11 is also known. (Commutative property of addition.)
